# Dilan Grijalva

> Personal portfolio of Dilan Grijalva, a software developer in Managua focused on mobile apps, backend services, and reliable product experiences.

This is a concise, single-page portfolio. Dilan works with TypeScript, Node.js, .NET, Kotlin, React, React Native, Go, MySQL, Java, PostgreSQL, AWS, and Azure.
